gaps_and_warnings: No Nigerian-specific salary data available in a3_market.json - all salary data is from other countries
Nigerian sample size is very small (11 respondents) - Nigerian market relevance assessments are directional, not statistically robust
Career mobility data in a3_market.json shows zero transitions across all roles - this may indicate a data collection artifact rather than actual stability
Remote work data in a3_market.json shows zero hybrid responses for all roles - likely incomplete survey field
Role 'Other (please specify):' is heterogeneous and cannot be reliably mapped to specific skills or domain
Role 'Retired' represents inactive respondents and has limited market intelligence value
Student salary data reflects internship/part-time work, not full-time market rates
Some salary data points have very small sample sizes (count < 5) and may not be representative
